_comment: Merge these four hook entries into the matching arrays of your ~/.claude/settings.json. Do NOT paste this file wholesale — it is a fragment. Claude Code runs each command through a shell, so $HOME expands; you may also use absolute paths. See INSTALL.md.

PostToolUse._comment: Second mode: catches a skill whose payload is a script driven straight from the shell, which the Skill tool never sees. Without this, script-payload skills under-count badly.
